outcomes.intro: By the end of the course, students will be able to:
items: Evaluate a real-world problem as a possible business opportunity
Build and test a venture using a Lean Canvas, market research, and financial evidence
Present and defend an original business concept in NFTE’s Fast Pitch Challenge
outcomes.closing: Students will leave with market research, a completed Lean Canvas, and a professional pitch deck, plus a clearer sense of which parts of entrepreneurship they may want to explore next.

who: This course is for middle school students who have completed 6th, 7th, or 8th grade and are curious about business, products, leadership, or solving problems that affect other people.
It fits students who enjoy creating ideas and want to learn how NFTE’s research, business-modeling, and financial tools can make those ideas stronger.
Students should be ready to collaborate, study potential customers, work with basic calculations, revise their thinking, and present to an audience.
The course guides students through the NFTE process from identifying a problem to delivering a final pitch.
Students must also meet the Institute for the Gifted eligibility requirements listed in the program FAQ and complete the program application.
en.focus: A strong business idea starts with a problem worth solving. Students look for unmet needs, test whether an idea could create real value, and narrow their thinking to one original venture concept.
